# UQDA Core v0.1.2

This maintenance release supersedes v0.1.1. It keeps the v0.1.1
network protocol and group-password derivation, so v0.1.1 nodes can be upgraded
without a coordinated network-wide restart.

## Installation and documentation

- Adds a project-owned Homebrew Cask installation path for macOS. Homebrew may
  require the scoped `brew trust --cask uqda/core/uqda` command because the
  Cask executes the project's verified installer.
- Expands the English project guide and adds release and verification documentation.

## macOS notice

The project still does not use a paid Apple Developer account. macOS packages
are explicitly named `*-unsigned.pkg`. Finder may display a Gatekeeper warning.
Use the command-line `install.sh` path or the project Homebrew Cask: the
installer verifies the package against this release's SHA-256 manifest before
invoking the macOS system installer. Do not disable Gatekeeper globally.

## Validation

The release quality gate reruns:

- unit tests, formatting, linting, CodeQL, reachable dependency scanning,
  race-sensitive coverage, and handshake fuzzing;
- Linux, Windows, and macOS builds/tests with the supported Go toolchains;
- FreeBSD and OpenBSD cross-builds;
- privileged two-node, multi-hop, failover, loss/latency, and secure-required
  mesh scenarios;
- installer platform selection and native package builds; and
- checksum generation, Sigstore verification, and GitHub provenance
  attestations.
